arStrings.szText: Shape of the Soul
Thales begs to have Phix's gift removed.

Thales has not taken well to Phix's gift. I have found him in Fool's Quarry, his eyes gouged out. He has begged me to help him find Phix, so that they may remove his "gift." I must search for Phix near the entrance to the mine.
Search for Phix near Scoriaceous Path
We have found Phix near the ruins of some strange Firstborn structure. I must speak with them.
Speak with Phix
The large tracks are distinctly bird like. They must belong to Phix. I must follow them.
Find Phix
Phix's tracks continue to the north. We must follow them if we are to find Phix and remove Thales' affliction.
Find Phix

Find Phix
I have found large tracks near the entrance to the mine. I should inspect them. Perhaps they will lead us to Phix.
Inspect the Large Tracks
Phix's tracks have led me to a peculiar location. It seems Phix spent some time here. I should inspect the object to gain more insight on why.
Inspect the Calcified Remains
It seems Phix has left behind an offering of sorts. Thales seems unsettled by what he sees. I should check to ensure he is faring well.
